evidence.text: Build a local web inventory for owned firearms with serial numbers, purchase dates, receipts, basic descriptive information, encryption and passphrase access. No actual inventory or secret data has been provided.
The repository was cloned successfully and was empty. There is no existing application or security implementation to preserve.

Supported scope: personal inventory and private documentation only. Exclude firearm or ammunition sourcing, price comparison, purchase alerts, and purchasing recommendations. Keep personal records and passphrases out of all model prompts. Local model output is advisory and cannot approve security.
